relations.rationale: Tess arriving before Ivo does not determine her order relative to Jude, since Ivo's and Jude's relative order is unknown.
Practicing openings all week is consistent with and plausibly motivates eagerness to try a new variation, though not strictly required.
Jude's eagerness to try a variation has no bearing on what scoring system will be used.
The system being used in the next match doesn't affect whether newer members found it confusing in the past.
The scoring system used has nothing to do with Xavi's height.
The scoring system for the next match is unrelated to Nell's promise about scheduling a meeting.
Confusion about the rating system among newer members is unrelated to whether games were finished by session's end.
Ivo's arrival order relative to Jude has no bearing on Xavi's height affecting shelf access.
Ivo arriving before Jude does not determine whether Tess arrived before Jude, since Tess's position relative to Ivo is unspecified.
The advisor checking attendance and leaving scoresheets are plausibly part of the same visit, so the first supports the occurrence of the second.
Leaving scoresheets on a table doesn't imply anything about whether games were finished.
Xavi being taller than most younger members directly supports the claim that his height helps him reach higher shelves.
Xavi's height helping him reach shelves has no connection to Nell's scheduling promise.
Unfinished games could motivate scheduling a follow-up meeting, providing some supportive connection, but it's not explicitly stated as the reason.
